title: GoPro Chin Mount Kit
features: Universal fit for most GoPro Hero models
Secure chin mount design for helmet or bar usage
Includes adhesive pads and mounting hardware
description:
Machined for unyielding stability in high-buffet slipstreams, the GoPro Chin Mount Kit from GoPro provides dependable hardware security and equipment mounting. Built with Marine-Grade 316 Stainless Steel & CNC Anodized Aluminum (Salt-Spray Resistant), it boasts an installation rating of 2.0 / 10 (Chin-mount curved adhesive contour bracket with anti-vibration damping).

The GoPro Chin Mount Kit delivers robust utility and rock-solid mechanical reliability from GoPro, giving riders an uncompromising platform for telemetry, camera capture, or secure helmet stowage.
